strongest_angle: Mayor Daniel Lurie and the San Francisco Board of Supervisors passed new October 2026 legislation prohibiting evictions for back rent under one month's threshold and requiring upfront fee disclosures.

key_facts.fact: On October 29, 2026, San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie signed two pieces of legislation protecting renters from unwarranted evictions and hidden rental fees.
The San Francisco Board of Supervisors voted unanimously on October 20, 2026, to require landlords to reveal total costs and recurring fees on all apartment listings.
San Francisco File number 260962 established new administrative code rules regarding evictions for nonpayment of rent, introduced on September 1, 2026.
key_facts.source_name: City and County of San Francisco

key_facts.fact: An analysis from the Urban Institute Initiative found that hidden fees for amenities, utilities, and trash can increase tenants' total monthly costs by 10 to 30 percent.
